events.title: Adapted Story Time
events.description: Join us for a welcoming Adapted Story Time designed for children ages 3-8 who benefit from a sensory-friendly environment. We will read stories, sing gentle songs, and explore movement and hands-on activities in a supportive setting. This story time is best suited for children with sensory sensitivities and their caregivers. To ensure this program remains accessible to families who need these supports, we ask that children who are comfortable in our family story times attend those offerings instead. Tickets available 1 hour prior to the program. Space is limited. Any person needing a reasonable accommodation for a disability to access the benefits of the Library’s services, programs, or activities under the Americans with Disabilities Act should contact the Library by telephone at (972) 292-5669, by email at library@friscotexas.gov , or in writing, not less than five (5) business days prior to the program.
